0022600085.text: Both the Orlando Magic and Atlanta Hawks open their 2026-27 seasons, with Orlando hosting and Izaiyah Nelson out after ankle surgery. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), and Mouhamed Gueye is day-to-day with a foot fracture and a game-time decision. The Magic lost their 2025-26 season series 0-4, including a 130-101 loss in Orlando on April 1, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Orlando a 55% chance to win.
